rejected_designs.reason: The secure_web_proxy module requires tls_inspection_policy_url and gateway_certificate_url. Neither a CA Service hierarchy nor a TLS inspection policy exists in any module or unit, the gateway is EXPLICIT_ROUTING_MODE so the guest must still be pointed at it and must still trust an interception CA, and intercepting a developer's whole session to install two packages is a posture decision, not a Terraform change.

google_compute_firewall accepts CIDRs only; the firewall module creates nothing else. deb.debian.org, security.debian.org, nixos.org, releases.nixos.org and cache.nixos.org are all shared-CDN fronted, so the rule would admit ranges that also front an arbitrary slice of the public internet and that change without notice. That is not bounded and not reviewable.
Turning the priority-65000 deny into an allow, or adding any 0.0.0.0/0 egress allow above it, removes the control the unit exists for. It is refused here and by validate-workstation-egress.

components.summary: An Artifact Registry APT remote repository proxying Debian, reached at <region>-apt.pkg.dev. 3-networks/shared/dns-hub already resolves *.pkg.dev to restricted.googleapis.com and 199.36.153.4/30:443 is already allowed, so this path needs no new firewall rule. The module hard-codes mode = STANDARD_REPOSITORY and its format enum is DOCKER/GO/MAVEN/NPM/PYTHON, so an APT remote repository cannot be declared today.

Nix arrives with the image rather than over the network. 5-workloads/ci/nix-binary-cache exports substituter_uri = null with reason raw-private-gcs-is-not-a-nix-substituter, and there is no Google-hosted mirror of the Nix installer, so no reachable substituter or installer source exists. var.image already accepts a full image self-link, but no VM image build pipeline exists in either repository and the startup script would still run its unconditional public fetch.

selected_design.summary: Everything the workstation needs at first boot comes from inside the perimeter over the restricted Google API VIP that the firewall already allows. No egress destination is added.

blocked_steps.step: apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends tmux git curl ca-certificates xz-utils
